an5.221:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā dīghacārikaṃ anavattha cārikaṃ anuyuttassa viharato.
an5.221:1.3: assutaṃ na suṇāti, sutaṃ na pariyodapeti, sutenekaccena avisārado hoti, bāḷhaṃ rogātaṅkaṃ phusati, na ca mittavā hoti.
an5.221:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā dīghacārikaṃ anavattha cārikaṃ anuyuttassa viharato.
an5.221:2.3: assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodapeti, sutenekaccena visārado hoti, na bāḷhaṃ rogātaṅkaṃ phusati, mittavā ca hoti.
an5.221:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā samavatthacāreti.
